user.title: Sign in with your Tuya app
user.description: Open the **Smart Life** or **Tuya Smart** app → **Me** → ⚙️ → **Account and Security** → **User Code**, and enter that code here. It is case-sensitive.

scan.title: Scan with your Tuya app
scan.description:
In the Smart Life / Tuya Smart app, tap the scan icon (top right of **Home**) and scan this code, approve the login, then press **Submit**.

Hawaii Local then imports your devices and controls them over your home network.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Tuya sign-in has expired or was revoked. Devices keep working locally meanwhile; sign in again so new or reset devices can be recovered.

error.invalid_user_code: That user code wasn't accepted. Check it in the Tuya app (it is case-sensitive).
error.not_scanned: The code hasn't been scanned and approved yet. A fresh code is shown; scan it, approve, then press Submit.

abort.already_configured: This Tuya account is already added.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Tuya account than the one this entry uses.

menu_options.refresh: Re-import devices from my Tuya account
menu_options.scan: Search my network for devices now
menu_options.device: Set a device's IP address or protocol

device.title: Choose a device
device.description: Devices and gateways with their current address.

device_settings.title: {name}
device_settings.description: Leave the IP empty to find it automatically (recommended). A fixed IP stops automatic IP finding for this device.

data_description.version: Leave on auto unless the device needs a specific version.

networks.title: Networks to search
networks.description: Hawaii Local finds devices on Home Assistant's own network automatically. If Home Assistant runs in Docker or on a different network from your devices, add your home network here, for example 192.168.0.0/24. Separate several with commas.

data_description.networks: A network like 192.168.0.0/24, or any device IP (its /24 network is searched).

error.invalid_networks: Enter networks like 192.168.0.0/24, separated by commas.
